adrs.ADR-0063: Accepted 2026-07-05 (eb1abba) — Chartered Workstreams: a standing operator-chartered objective that creates Runs on a schedule (the third initiator). The charter's authority IS a v0.6 delegation grant, auto-issued in-tx (grantee workstream:<id>, 1:1) — no third authority model; the immutable sealed plan template binds consent to the reviewed artifact (GOV-8); an in-process ticker (no cron dep; single-winner CAS claim, no backfill, self-retire on a dead grant) fires due charters through the SHARED run.LaunchBounded core (one plan-vs-grant + PERF-7 validator, two callers — SEC-30); actor = workstream:<id> on the ADR-0062 split (agent = any non-human actor under delegated authority; agent-tool edge reused, seven-edge set unchanged); windowed step budget (nullable budget_window_seconds; NULL = v0.6 semantics); pause soft / retire = revoke the grant + cascade. Extends ADR-0061 + ADR-0062; preserves ADR-0060 trivially (zero gateway change, no new key/mint); edits no Accepted ADR (G2-clean).
